token = apis.simple_note.login(username='ta.weav@gmail.com', password='svA5pJX')['access_token']
note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=1642, access_token=token)
print('note_id', note['note_id'])
print('title', note['title'])
content = note['content']
print('content_length', len(content))
print('content_preview', content[:500])
import re
# Count unchecked items patterns like [ ] or [ ] with optional whitespace after dash/bullet
not_done_count = len(re.findall(r'\[\s*\]\s*(?=\S)', content))
done_count = len(re.findall(r'\[\s*[xX]\s*\]', content))
print('not_done_count_raw', not_done_count)
print('done_count_raw', done_count)
# Also count bullet-style '- [ ]' and '- [x]'
not_done_bullet = len(re.findall(r'-\s*\[\s*\]\s*', content))
done_bullet = len(re.findall(r'-\s*\[\s*[xX]\s*\]\s*', content))
print('not_done_bullet', not_done_bullet)
print('done_bullet', done_bullet)
# Print unique lines containing [ ]
lines=[ln for ln in content.splitlines() if '[' in ln and ']' in ln]
check_lines=[ln for ln in lines if re.search(r'\[\s*\]', ln)]
print('num_lines_with_[ ]', len(check_lines))
print('sample_check_lines', check_lines[:10])

token = apis.simple_note.login(username='ta.weav@gmail.com', password='svA5pJX')['access_token']
note=apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=1642, access_token=token)
import re
content=note['content']
not_done_items=[]
for ln in content.splitlines():
    m=re.match(r'^\[\s*\]\s*(.+)$', ln.strip())
    if m:
        not_done_items.append(m.group(1))
print('not_done_items', not_done_items)
print('not_done_count', len(not_done_items))
# also check for bullet style (not expected)
not_done_items_bullet=[]
for ln in content.splitlines():
    m=re.match(r'^-\s*\[\s*\]\s*(.+)$', ln.strip())
    if m:
        not_done_items_bullet.append(m.group(1))
print('not_done_items_bullet', not_done_items_bullet)
print('total_not_done', len(not_done_items)+len(not_done_items_bullet))
